meta.name: ohmycaptcha-image
meta.description: Generate product visuals, README banners, documentation illustrations, and architecture diagrams for OhMyCaptcha. Use when the user asks for repository art, hero images, deployment diagrams, or marketing visuals for captcha infrastructure projects.
